title: Autumn Walk
summary: Seasonal finds for a longer wander through a park or woodland edge.

targets.clue: Crunch through a pile of fallen leaves, then photograph them on the ground.
targets.label: fallen autumn leaves on the ground

targets.clue: Check the damp spots under trees. Photograph a mushroom. Do not eat it.
targets.label: a mushroom

targets.clue: Find a pine cone or a conker lying under a tree and photograph it.
targets.label: a pine cone

targets.clue: Look up and along the branches. Photograph a squirrel if one shows itself.
targets.label: a squirrel

targets.clue: Look for a spider web catching the light between plants, and photograph it.
targets.label: a spider web
